about.title: THE ARCHITECTS OF
about.description: Master&Beats is a modern electro-acoustic duo from Serbia founded in 2019, combining electric accordion (Miloš Mladenović) and acoustic accordion (Dušan Đorđević). They fuse expressive accordion artistry with cutting-edge EDM, pop, and electronic sounds.

milos.name: MILOŠ MLADENOVIĆ
milos.bio: Miloš redefines the accordion as a futuristic synthesizer controller. Harnessing polyphonic MIDI triggers, digital bellows expression, and custom distortion matrices, he unleashes blistering leads, piercing arpeggios, and heavy basslines that drive the duo's peak-time club and festival drops.
milos.sig1: Bellows-controlled cutoff filter & pitch bend expression
milos.sig3: Live trigger pads firing 808 sub drops and tech-house stabs

dusan.name: DUŠAN ĐORĐEVIĆ
dusan.instrument: Concert Chamber Resonance & Folk Balkan Soul
dusan.bio: Dušan provides the beating human heart of the duo. Trained in rigorous classical accordion concert literature and steeped in deep Serbian folklore, his acoustic instrument commands organic warmth, rapid-fire ornamental Balkan runs, and soaring melodic harmonies that breathe organic life into modern electronic beats.
dusan.sig1: Double-reed cassotto resonance chamber acoustic richness
dusan.sig2: Complex 7/8, 9/8 and 11/8 Serbian and Balkan dance meters
dusan.sig3: Custom studio condenser mic capsule pickups for high fidelity

sonic.el1Body: Electric bellows pressure translates in real time into cutoff frequencies, wavetable distortion, and envelope triggers, transforming physical accordion gestures into explosive synth modulations.
sonic.el2Body: Rather than using canned backing tracks, both artists perform in tight polyphonic dialogue. Miloš handles digital leads and sub-bass while Dušan responds with acoustic counter-melodies.
sonic.el3Body: Rooted in centuries of South Slavic accordion tradition, their music integrates microtonal inflections, ornamental trills, and lightning-speed chromatic triplets into futuristic dance tempos.
